headline: Fortinet Shares Fall as Growth Slows in Key Business Segment
summary: Fortinet shares drop following its earnings report as growth slows significantly in one of the cybersecurity company's business segments.
why: Fortinet is a major player in the cybersecurity sector, and its growth metrics serve as an important indicator for demand across enterprise security software.

impacts.name: Fortinet Inc
impacts.why: Slower growth in a key business segment directly impacts investor sentiment and share valuation.

impacts.name: Cybersecurity
impacts.why: Broader cybersecurity stocks fell alongside Fortinet as growth concerns weighed on the sector.

why_moved: Shares dropped because growth slowed significantly in one of Fortinet's business segments, which also dragged down broader cybersecurity stocks.
